The Access Studio All In One Access Management App is a comprehensive solution for configuring precise access rights across fields, models, menus, and views for any module and user in Odoo. It simplifies access control compared to record rules, centralizes and customizes user-wise permissions, and ensures users only see what they need. With easy configuration, it supports access group management, organizational structures, and advanced user roles. Key features include the ability to hide or restrict fields, buttons, tabs, contacts, menus, reports, actions, server actions, import/export/delete/archive functions, chatter, filters, and smart buttons. It enables readonly or invisible fields, readonly users, and full system lockdowns. The app allows granular control over every UI element and supports restricting or making read-only various components like fields, views, and actions. It manages access across modules including Sales supports multi-company environments. All In One Access Manager app for setting the correct access rights (Hide/Unhide/Read-only) on fields, models, menus, records, filters, groups, buttons/tabs, views, actions, reports, chatter for any module, any user, any company. This app lets you control what users can see and do, all from one place, with just a few clicks. No need for technical skills or complex setups.Perfect for businesses seeking a straightforward solution to access management.
